T: For the greater good. And the cheese board.
D: A top London cop is reassigned to a quiet country village where the accidents keep piling up.
P: Serve the drinks when Angel orders a cranberry juice at the pub.
S: where Angel turfs out the underage drinkers

Thick slices of mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, a chunky brown pickle, apple and crusty bread with salted butter on a wooden board. Take 250g mature cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead and cut into thick slices. Cut a pork pie into wedges. Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, a sliced apple, crusty bread and a dish of salted butter.
Village of the Year fete scotch eggs
Sandford's pride, the fete with the coconut shy

Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Wrap each in 100g seasoned sausage mince. Roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 7 minutes, halve and serve with English mustard.
Neighbourhood Watch pork and apple rolls

Pork sausage mince with grated apple, sage and onion rolled in flaky puff pastry, glazed with egg and fennel seeds and baked deep golden, with brown sauce. Mix 600g pork sausage mince with a grated green apple, a finely diced onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage and pepper. Cut 3 sheets puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each and roll up, sealing with beaten egg. Brush with egg, sprinkle with fennel seeds and cut into 4cm pieces. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until deep golden. Serve with brown sauce.
M: Greater good steak and ale pie
the Neighbourhood Watch motto, said in unison

Beef chuck braised in dark ale with onion, thyme and a little Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme, 375ml ale and a dash of Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and pour into a pie dish. Cover with puff, bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with chips and 300g peas.
Supermarket roast chicken and bread sauce
the village supermarket with its smiling manager

Whole chicken roasted golden, with roast potatoes cooked in the chicken fat, honey roast carrots and a creamy clove-studded bread sauce. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter and salt and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, and rest. Parboil 1kg potatoes, roast in the chicken fat for 50 minutes. Toss 500g carrots in honey and oil and roast 30 minutes. Simmer 400ml milk with an onion studded with 4 cloves for 10 minutes, remove the onion and stir in 80g fresh breadcrumbs and 20g butter.
W: Waffle cones filled with strawberry ice cream rippled with fresh strawberry sauce, dipped in dark chocolate and chopped nuts, frozen until serving.
K: Angel's cranberry lime cooler, no ice
Angel's order at the pub, no ice

Cranberry juice chilled hard and shaken with fresh lime and a little ginger syrup, poured into a cold pint glass with no ice, topped with soda. Chill 800ml cranberry juice and four pint glasses in the fridge for 3 hours. Simmer 60g sugar, 60ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each glass, shake 200ml cranberry juice with the juice of half a lime and 15ml ginger syrup, pour into a cold pint glass and top with soda water. No ice.

steps.text: Take the cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead so it comes up to room temperature.
Cut the cheddar into thick slices and the pork pie into wedges.
Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, sliced apple and bread, with a dish of butter.

dishes.n: Village of the Year fete scotch eggs
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, serve cold or reheat at 180C

steps.text: Boil four of the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Wrap each egg in seasoned sausage mince, pressing it smooth and even.
Roll in flour, the remaining beaten egg, then panko.
Fry at 170C until deep golden and cooked through, then halve.
Serve with English mustard.

dishes.n: Greater good steak and ale pie

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches and soften the sliced onions.
Add thyme, ale and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and braise gently until the beef is tender.
Thicken the sauce with the flour mixed to a paste, simmer, then tip into a pie dish and cool slightly.
Top with puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cut the potatoes into chips, fry until golden, and boil the peas. Serve alongside.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep frozen

steps.text: Blitz the strawberries with the sugar to a sauce.
Soften the ice cream, ripple the sauce through and refreeze until firm.
Melt the chocolate and dip the rims of the cones, then dip in chopped peanuts.
Fill with scoops and freeze until serving.

steps.text: Chill the cranberry juice and four pint glasses in the fridge.
Simmer the sugar, water and sliced ginger for 5 minutes and cool.
Shake the cranberry juice with lime juice and ginger syrup, pour into cold glasses and top with soda water. No ice.
